body.text:
yes, we should do away with the grace period!

[`"Concurrent refresh with the same token should be treated as reuse"`](<https://tangled.org/tranquil.farm/tranquil-pds/pulls/689/0#file-crates/tranquil-pds/tests/it/oauth_security.rs:R806>) -- could we maybe be permissive of concurrent refreshes? this seems like [typical behavior](https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto/blob/f136380964a8ea52ef031a9732d3d1f1f1ab0c4a/packages/oauth/oauth-client/src/session-getter.ts#L124-L171) and we should be within spec to decline to re-rotate on concurrent reuse without revoking since these are sender-bound by dpop? that should be a much narrower scenario than the original grace window

the ref pds *does* appear to allow similar behavior if Im understanding [this comment](https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto/blob/87e6a95c39f199e53b6a68b7d1fa23fbe8459753/packages/oauth/oauth-provider/src/token/token-manager.ts#L348-L373) correctly though that may change..
